# With a path prefix, the "/" route still matches every path: every path
# under the prefix. The request for the prefix without its trailing slash
# is redirected to it, as http.ServeMux does for any subtree, and the
# index route path is the prefix with the slash.

muxt generate --output-routes-func-with-path-prefix-param
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /"}}root {{.Request.URL.Path}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /a"}}a{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestRootUnderPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	for _, prefix := range []string{"/app", "/app/"} {
		t.Run(prefix, func(t *testing.T) {
			mux := http.NewServeMux()
			paths := TemplateRoutes(mux, nil, prefix)

			if got, want := paths.ReadIndex(), "/app/"; got != want {
				t.Errorf("ReadIndex() = %q, want %q", got, want)
			}

			for _, tt := range []struct {
				path, body string
				code       int
				location   string
			}{
				{path: "/app", location: "/app/"},
				{path: "/app/", code: http.StatusOK, body: "root /app/"},
				{path: "/app/anything", code: http.StatusOK, body: "root /app/anything"},
				{path: "/app/a", code: http.StatusOK, body: "a"},
				{path: "/elsewhere", code: http.StatusNotFound},
			} {
				rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
				mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.path, nil))
				// The redirect's status depends on the Go version.
				if tt.location != "" && rec.Code/100 != 3 {
					t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want a redirect", tt.path, rec.Code)
				}
				if tt.location == "" && rec.Code != tt.code {
					t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.path, rec.Code, tt.code)
				}
				if tt.body != "" && rec.Body.String() != tt.body {
					t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", tt.path, rec.Body.String(), tt.body)
				}
				if got := rec.Header().Get("Location"); got != tt.location {
					t.Errorf("GET %s Location = %q, want %q", tt.path, got, tt.location)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRootWithoutPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	paths := TemplateRoutes(mux, nil, "")

	if got, want := paths.ReadIndex(), "/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("ReadIndex() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	for _, p := range []string{"/", "/anything", "/x/y"} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, p, nil))
		if want := "root " + p; rec.Code != http.StatusOK || rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want 200 %q", p, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	}
}
